say:2:1012204001:0.text: How long do we have to stay here with this hornleaf bear? He's too loud. He might attract his friends here...
say:2:1012204001:0.source_cn: 咱还要跟这头叶角熊耗下去吗？它叫得太响了，我怕它会引来...

say:3:1012204002:0.text: What are you scared for?! It's just one hornleaf bear!
say:3:1012204002:0.source_cn: 看你那怂样！区区一只叶角熊你也怕！

say:4:1012204003:0.text: This fella is pretty tough, though. It keeps attacking itself and using the pain to try and keep sane. I love how it struggles.
say:4:1012204003:0.source_cn: 这家伙还挺顽强，它一直在攻击自己，用痛苦维持理智。我就...

say:5:1012204004:0.text: Do we have any more of those <style="highlight">pills</style>? A few more and I think it'll be under our control.

say:6:1012204005:0.text: No more, Boss... You know that there's something going on in Ryeham. There aren't enough Gemvine grapes to go around, and the Syndicate can't provide more pills.
say:6:1012204005:0.source_cn: 没了头儿……你也知道，金穗村那边出了点乱子，藤水晶不够...

say:10:1012204006:0.text: It's the cursed Adamant Syndicate again... What have they been feeding the hornleaf bears?
say:10:1012204006:0.source_cn: 又是可恶的黑金商会……他们给叶角熊吃了什么！

say:13:1012204007:0.text: That hornleaf bear is in pain... Could it be the friend that Hewynn was speaking of?
say:13:1012204007:0.source_cn: 那只叶角熊很痛苦……难道伊温说的朋友，是这只叶角熊吗？

say:14:1012204008:0.text: There was no mistaking it. Hewynn said her friend was gentle and fluffy. That's exactly how you would describe a hornleaf bear!
say:14:1012204008:0.source_cn: 错不了，伊温说他的朋友很温柔，还是个毛绒绒，那不就是平...

say:15:1012204009:0.text: We cannot allow these people to harm the creatures of the forest! Let's move!
say:15:1012204009:0.source_cn: 不能任凭这些人伤害生灵，上吧！

say:3:1012206002:0.text: As far as I know, hornleaf bears give each other leaves as a sign of friendship. And this leaf... was originally placed over his heart.
say:3:1012206002:0.source_cn: 据我所知，叶角熊们会互相赠送身上的叶子，以示友好。而这...

say:4:1012206003:0.text: A gift of the leaves covering their hearts is how hornleaf bears express their gratitude.
say:4:1012206003:0.source_cn: 叶角熊想表达感激时，会把覆在心脏周围的叶子当做礼物送出。

say:5:1012206004:0.text: How do we explain to Hewynn that we couldn't save her friend?
say:5:1012206004:0.source_cn: ……该怎么和伊温交代啊？我们没能救下她的朋友。

choice_prompt:6:1012206004.text: How do we explain to Hewynn that we couldn't save her friend?
choice_prompt:6:1012206004.source_cn: ……该怎么和伊温交代啊？我们没能救下她的朋友。

say:7:1012206005:0.text: I agree. Eventually, all lies are discovered. It's best to be honest with her. She's strong enough to handle it.
say:7:1012206005:0.source_cn: 我认同你的看法。谎言早晚会被识破，还是应该将实情告诉她...
say:7:1012206005:0.male: I agree. Eventually, all lies are discovered. It's best to be honest with her. She's strong enough to handle it.
say:7:1012206005:0.female: I agree. Eventually, all lies are discovered. It's best to be honest with her. She's strong enough to handle it.

say:8:1012206007:0.text: Curses! Where else has the dirty tendrils of the Syndicate spread?
say:8:1012206007:0.source_cn: 可恶！黑金商会的脏手到底还要伸到哪里？！

say:9:1012206008:0.text: Eomir! That leech! I will never forgive him! He's the one that's bringing all these carrion-eaters into our forest!
say:9:1012206008:0.source_cn: 伊米尔这只蛀虫……我绝对饶不了他！都是他把这些祸害引到...

say:11:1012206009:0.text: Save your words until we meet Eomir face-to-face.
say:11:1012206009:0.source_cn: 这些话，还是等见到了伊米尔再说。

say:12:1012206010:0.text: Miss Hewynn is waiting for us. She needs to know... Let's head back to Lovers' Wish.
say:12:1012206010:0.source_cn: 伊温小姐在等我们，她迟早要面对这些……我们回情人之愿吧。

say:14:1012206006:0.text: You're very kind. However, I think it would be better to tell her the truth rather than lie. Hewynn is stronger than we think.
say:14:1012206006:0.source_cn: 你很善良。可我觉得与其欺骗她，不如让她知道真相。伊温很...
say:14:1012206006:0.male: You're very kind. However, I think it would be better to tell her the truth rather than lie. Hewynn is stronger than we think.
say:14:1012206006:0.female: You're very kind. However, I think it would be better to tell her the truth rather than lie. Hewynn is stronger than we think.

say:2:1012209001:0.text: Even if it's bad news... p-please tell me.
say:2:1012209001:0.source_cn: 我……我做好准备了……即便是糟糕的消息，也请告诉我吧。

choice_prompt:3:1012209001.text: Even if it's bad news... p-please tell me.
choice_prompt:3:1012209001.source_cn: 我……我做好准备了……即便是糟糕的消息，也请告诉我吧。

say:4:1012209002:0.text: This was his leaf... the pretty one, right over his heart.
say:4:1012209002:0.source_cn: 这是他的叶子……最漂亮的那一片，长在心口的那一片。

say:6:1012209004:0.text: Our deepest apologies... we couldn't save your friend.
say:6:1012209004:0.source_cn: 抱歉……我们没能救下你的朋友。

say:7:1012209005:0.text: There's no need to apologize! He wasn't your responsibility!
say:7:1012209005:0.source_cn: 不……还请不要道歉！并不是你们的责任！

say:8:1012209006:0.text: Thank you for bringing back his leaf.
say:8:1012209006:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们……谢谢你们带回了这片叶子。

say:9:1012209007:0.text: Hornleaf bears bury their deceased companions... I wish to <style="highlight">bury this leaf</style>.
say:9:1012209007:0.source_cn: 叶角熊会埋葬去世的同伴，我想……<style=high...

say:0:1012209101:0.text: What exquisitely gentle magic... Thank you.
say:0:1012209101:0.source_cn: 多么精致而温柔的魔法……谢谢你。
say:0:1012209101:0.male: What exquisitely gentle magic... Thank you.
say:0:1012209101:0.female: What exquisitely gentle magic... Thank you.

say:3:1012210002:0.text: I was born of the Taran River. It's my duty to protect all the creatures that the river nurtures, but I couldn't even protect my friend...
say:3:1012210002:0.source_cn: 我诞生自塔兰河，我的责任，是保护塔兰河抚育的所有生灵。...

say:4:1012210003:0.text: My rain can only slow the spread of corruption. That is the only thing I can do. I am useless!
say:4:1012210003:0.source_cn: 我的雨，只能延缓污染扩散，我能做到的……仅仅只有这些…...

say:5:1012210004:0.text: You tried your best, Hewynn. Don't blame yourself.
say:5:1012210004:0.source_cn: 伊温，你已经很努力了，不要责怪自己。

say:6:1012210005:0.text: The villagers of Taran fell sick from drinking corrupted river water, and Granny Fennel needs your dewdrops to make medicine for everyone.
say:6:1012210005:0.source_cn: 塔兰村的村民们喝了被污染的水，茴姆婆婆需要用你的露珠为...

say:7:1012210006:0.text: You're the only one that can help us.
say:7:1012210006:0.source_cn: 眼下，这是只有你才能做到的事。

say:8:1012210007:0.text: But if I hand over the dewdrops, I won't be able to continue this rain of purification. The corruption will worsen!
say:8:1012210007:0.source_cn: 可是，交出露珠后，我无法继续降下净化之雨，污染……会变...

say:9:1012210008:0.text: I don't want to see people suffer, but I also can't let the corruption continue to spread... What am I supposed to do...?!
say:9:1012210008:0.source_cn: 我不想看到大家受苦，但我也不能让污染继续扩散……我到底...

say:10:1012210009:0.text: Hewynn, a drop of water cannot change the course of a river. You're not fighting alone. You have us.
say:10:1012210009:0.source_cn: 伊温，一滴水无法汇聚成河川。你不是一个人在战斗，还有我们。

say:11:1012210010:0.text: Please have faith that we will find a way to restore not only Lovers' Wish but the entire Vaduso Mountains and the Dark Forest to what they once were.
say:11:1012210010:0.source_cn: 请你相信我们会找到办法，不仅是情人之愿，整个瓦度索山脉...

say:12:1012210011:0.text: I'm not alone in this, am I?
say:12:1012210011:0.source_cn: 我不是一个人，在努力？我并不孤单，对吗？

say:13:1012210012:0.text: Hewynn, we want to save this land as much as you do. And the people in Taran Village need you very much.
say:13:1012210012:0.source_cn: 伊温，我们和你一样，都很想拯救自己的家园。而塔兰村的那...

say:14:1012210013:0.text: Yes, I believe the words you speak!

say:15:1012210014:0.text: If this is what it takes to save everyone, then take all of my dewdrops!
say:15:1012210014:0.source_cn: 如果，这才是我该做的事，我愿意将露珠交给你！

say:16:1012210015:0.text: I'll be here waiting for your safe return... Please return with some good news...
say:16:1012210015:0.source_cn: 姐姐，我会在这里等你们回来……你们，一定要带着好消息回...

say:0:1012210101:0.text: We've got the dewdrops. Let's report back to Granny Fennel.
say:0:1012210101:0.source_cn: 拿到露珠了，去塔兰村告诉茴姆婆婆吧。

say:1:1012212001:1.text: You're back. Did you find Hewynn?
say:1:1012212001:1.source_cn: 你们回来了，见到伊温了吗？

choice_prompt:2:1012212001.text: You're back. Did you find Hewynn?
choice_prompt:2:1012212001.source_cn: 你们回来了，见到伊温了吗？

say:3:1012212002:1.text: Yes, these are Hewynn's dewdrops! Everyone is saved!
say:3:1012212002:1.source_cn: 没错，这就是伊温小姐的露珠！晶莹剔透，蕴藏着温柔的治愈...

say:4:1012212003:1.text: I'll brew the medicine right now! Please help me distribute the cure to everyone. Thank you so much!
say:4:1012212003:1.source_cn: 我这就重新调制草药！然后请你帮我把草药分给大家，实在是...
say:4:1012212003:1.male: I'll brew the medicine right now! Please help me distribute the cure to everyone. Thank you so much!
say:4:1012212003:1.female: I'll brew the medicine right now! Please help me distribute the cure to everyone. Thank you so much!

say:1:1012213001:0.text: Thank you for your help, outlander!
say:1:1012213001:0.source_cn: 外乡人……谢谢你们的帮助！
say:1:1012213001:0.male: Thank you for your help, outlander!
say:1:1012213001:0.female: Thank you for your help, outlander!

say:2:1012213002:0.text: I didn't like outlanders before... That was my fault. I was being too narrow-minded. Please forgive me.
say:2:1012213002:0.source_cn: 我之前很讨厌外乡人……是我太狭隘了！还请原谅！
say:2:1012213002:0.male: I didn't like outlanders before... That was my fault. I was being too narrow-minded. Please forgive me.
say:2:1012213002:0.female: I didn't like outlanders before... That was my fault. I was being too narrow-minded. Please forgive me.

say:1:1012214001:0.text: My daughter almost lost her life. Thanks to you, she'll live. You have my sincere gratitude.
say:1:1012214001:0.source_cn: 我的女儿差点丢掉性命，多亏了你们！真不知道该怎么感激才好！

say:2:1012214002:0.text: You are the saviors of Taran Village! May the Deer Spirit bless you always!
say:2:1012214002:0.source_cn: 你们是塔兰村的救世主！愿鹿灵永远保佑你们！

say:0:1012216001:0.text: Everyone has medicine. I'll ask if the elder needs more help.
say:0:1012216001:0.source_cn: 药品分发完毕，我去问问茴姆是否还需要其他帮助。

say:1:1012217001:1.source_cn: 太好啦，大家都渐渐恢复精神了！

say:2:1012217002:1.text: There is a school to the northeast of Lovers' Wish called <style="highlight">Jade Lake Academy</style>. There are quite a few children there. I'm worried about them.
say:2:1012217002:1.source_cn: 在情人之愿的东北有一所学校，名为<style=high...

say:3:1012217003:1.text: Although <style="highlight">they have a great teacher</style>, there might be trouble. I've made another batch of medicine, just in case. Please go check up on them.
say:3:1012217003:1.source_cn: 尽管他们<style=highlight>有个很厉害的...

say:8:1012217006:1.text: The teacher at Jade Lake Academy is very knowledgeable. She knows Master Arden and may have news of him. Seek her out, and you may find answers.
say:8:1012217006:1.source_cn: 翡湖学院那位老师非常博识，她和雅顿贤者认识，或许知道雅...

say:9:1012217007:1.text: Tell the people at the academy that you are a friend of mine, and they will let you in. Thank you again!
say:9:1012217007:1.source_cn: 只要报上我的名字，翡湖学院的人一定会让你们进去。麻烦你们了！

say:0:1012218001:0.text: Isn't <style="highlight">Florabelle</style> the teacher at Jade Lake Academy?

say:3:1012218004:0.text: When Lyca and I were pupils, Florabelle was our upperclassman.
say:3:1012218004:0.source_cn: 学生时期，芙拉贝尔是我和莱卡的师姐。

say:2:1012219003:0.text: I think I'm getting sick too...

say:2:1012220001:0.text: This medicine can cure you, little ones.
say:2:1012220001:0.source_cn: 小朋友，这些草药可以治疗你们的病痛。

say:3:1012220002:0.text: You're strangers. Can we even trust you? We won't be easily fooled.
say:3:1012220002:0.source_cn: 没见过的面孔呢，你们的话能信吗？我们可不是好骗的小孩子。

say:4:1012220003:0.text: We're friends. Granny Fennel sent us to bring you medicine.
say:4:1012220003:0.source_cn: 我们不是坏人，是塔兰村的茴姆婆婆嘱咐我们把草药送来。

say:7:1012220004:0.text: No! Our teacher told us not to accept things from strangers! Even if the stranger is a pretty lady!
say:7:1012220004:0.source_cn: 不吃不吃！老师说不能吃陌生人给的东西！就算你是漂亮姐姐...

say:10:1012220005:0.text: That's right... I don't want it...

say:12:1012220006:0.text: It's alright, children. She's an old friend of mine.
say:12:1012220006:0.source_cn: 孩子们，放心吧，那位姐姐可是老师的好朋友哦。

say:1:1012222001:1.text: ... Lorsan, what did you just say?
say:1:1012222001:1.source_cn: 噢呵呵……洛桑，你刚才，叫我什么来着？

say:2:1012222002:1.text: Uh... It's great to see you again, Master Arden.
say:2:1012222002:1.source_cn: 呃，当然是尊敬的雅顿老师。

say:3:1012222003:1.text: Hmm... I must be losing my hearing. I swear I heard you call me an old geezer.
say:3:1012222003:1.source_cn: 嗯……可能是我上了年纪，耳背，我怎么听着是老爷子呢？

say:4:1012222004:1.text: *Nervous laughter*... Yes, you misheard. Anyway, we've been looking for you everywhere, Master Arden. Who knew you were here at the Jade Lake Academy this whole time?
say:4:1012222004:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈……是您听错了。雅顿老师，我们一直在找您！没想到...

say:5:1012222005:1.text: Florabelle was in a bit of a bind, and I was worried about the children.
say:5:1012222005:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔遇到了一些麻烦，我也放心不下这些孩子。

say:7:1012222006:0.text: No wonder the Jade Lake Academy wasn't affected. Both you and Florabelle were here to protect and shield the area.
say:7:1012222006:0.source_cn: 难怪翡湖学院没有受到影响，原来是您和芙拉贝尔在此设下了加护。

say:8:1012222007:1.text: Compared to Magister Merlin, our enchantments are crude.
say:8:1012222007:1.source_cn: 和梅林相比，我们两个的加护魔法拙劣粗糙，不值一提。
say:8:1012222007:1.male: Compared to Magister Merlin, our enchantments are crude.
say:8:1012222007:1.female: Compared to Magister Merlin, our enchantments are crude.

say:9:1012222008:1.text: You seem to know that Eomir is making a mess of the Dark Forest. Why don't you go back and stop him?
say:9:1012222008:1.source_cn: 您似乎早知道伊米尔把丛林搞得一团糟了？那您怎么不早点回...

say:10:1012222009:1.text: Lorsan, I'm too old to fight Eomir... That is not the way. A vision has told me that there are other things I must do.
say:10:1012222009:1.source_cn: 洛桑……我老了，难以和伊米尔抗衡。占卜的结果告诉我，还...

say:11:1012222010:1.text: According to Granny Dahnie, there is a direct way to pray and communicate to Misarte hidden in the Vaduso Mountains. Is this true?
say:11:1012222010:1.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆说，瓦度索山脉中隐藏着直接拜谒弥萨忒的方法。...

say:13:1012222012:1.text: According to my studies, the legendary place where Misarte occasionally reveals herself is in <style="highlight">Ivoryshade</style>. It's northeast of the Vaduso Mountains.
say:13:1012222012:1.source_cn: 根据我的研究……传说中能够谒见弥萨忒之地——<styl...

choice_prompt:14:1012222012.text: According to my studies, the legendary place where Misarte occasionally reveals herself is in <style="highlight">Ivoryshade</style>. It's northeast of the Vaduso Mountains.
choice_prompt:14:1012222012.source_cn: 根据我的研究……传说中能够谒见弥萨忒之地——<style=highlight>月影乡</style>，它就在瓦度索山脉东北方。

say:15:1012222013:1.text: There is a legend that claims the Wildmother herself blessed this sanctuary. Ivoryshade's inhabitants are cut off from the outside world and tasked with guarding over the <style="highlight">altar of Misarte</style>.
say:15:1012222013:1.source_cn: 相传，那是一片被弥萨忒庇佑的世外桃源。月影乡与外界隔绝...

say:16:1012222014:1.text: Only there can you see the <style="highlight">true form of the Deer Spirit</style>.

say:17:1012222015:1.text: Journey to Ivoryshade and ask Misarte how the Dark Forest can be saved. This task I set upon you.
say:17:1012222015:1.source_cn: 谒见弥萨忒，向祂询问如何才能拯救薄暮丛林。这是你们眼下...

say:18:1012222016:0.text: But, Master Arden, Ivoryshade is just a legend. No one has actually been there. Are you sure...?
say:18:1012222016:0.source_cn: 雅顿老师……月影乡只是一个传说，没人真的去过那里。你的...

say:19:1012222017:1.text: Lorsan, go confirm with your own eyes and ears. Take your companions and <style="highlight">go northeast</style>.
say:19:1012222017:1.source_cn: 洛桑，靠你自己的耳朵和双眼去确认吧，和你的伙伴们一起，...

say:20:1012222018:1.text: Misarte will not stand idly by while danger befalls the Lucent Tree. If you lose your way, just look for the <style="highlight">butterflies</style> on your journey.
say:20:1012222018:1.source_cn: 流荧树遭遇危险，弥萨忒不会坐视不管。如果你们迷失方向，...

say:21:1012222019:1.text: I'll be here when you all return.
say:21:1012222019:1.source_cn: 我会在这里等你们回来。

say:0:1012223001:0.text: The Vaduso Mountains are so big! Where could Ivoryshade be?
say:0:1012223001:0.source_cn: 瓦度索山脉这么大！上哪去找传说中月影乡啊？

say:1:1012223002:0.text: Master Arden told us to look for the butterflies. I wonder...
say:1:1012223002:0.source_cn: 老师提醒我们注意旅途中的蝴蝶，不知有什么深意。

say:6:1012221001:1.text: Please take the medicine she brought. It'll make you feel better.
say:6:1012221001:1.source_cn: 孩子们，这位姐姐带来的草药可以放心服用，乖乖吃下去，病...

say:7:1012221002:1.text: If you say so, Miss Florabelle... It's so bitter...
say:7:1012221002:1.source_cn: 老师都这么说的话……可是，草药很苦……

say:8:1012221003:0.text: Finish all your medicine, and I'll give you your favorite candies.
say:8:1012221003:0.source_cn: 别怕！只要你喝完药，我就把最喜欢的糖果给你吃！

say:11:1012221004:1.text: If you don't take your medicine, your stomachaches will get worse. Please listen to Miss Florabelle.
say:11:1012221004:1.source_cn: 再不喝药，肚子会更痛，你最好听老师的话。

say:12:1012221005:1.text:
*Cry*... Okay...
Ah, it tastes so bad!
say:12:1012221005:1.source_cn: 呜……好吧……\n咕嘟咕嘟——果然很苦！

say:13:1012221006:1.text: But my belly feels better now... all warm...
say:13:1012221006:1.source_cn: 不过……肚子暖暖的，很舒服……
